name: thesis-review
description: Auto-maintain the belief layer (W8 belief-maintenance loop). Two modes: (1) digest refresh (B4) — re-synthesize the supporting digest for developing theses that accumulated new claims, delta-triggered, digest only; (2) signal derivation (B5) — derive a monitoring thesis's qualitative confirmation/invalidation/completion signals from its claims. Neither changes thesis status (the cascade owns it). Use when asked to 'refresh thesis digests', 'derive signals', 'run thesis-review', 'resynthesize articulations', or to process the digest/signal worklists.
